decisions.reason: After already withdrawing other express variants, management is likely to retain the seventy-two-hour program as the main expedited offer unless delivery strain or margins fall clearly below aspiration.
The certified fire-resistant steel exterior door fits the firm's core safety-engineering capabilities and likely meets aspiration well enough to justify continued market presence.

The fire and smoke protection door is a close complement to the established compliant-safety range, so a large firm with some slack would usually keep it unless sales disappoint relative to aspiration.
